faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate - I position at CSIR NIO is 13th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. / M.Sc. (Tech.) / M. Tech. degree in Geophysics, Marine Geophysics, Exploration Geophysics, or Applied Geophysics, along with a valid NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - I position in the National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - I position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 31,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for CSIR NIO Project Associate - I jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Associate - I at CSIR NIO is a contractual role. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR NIO located?
faq.answer: The National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO) is located in Goa, India.

faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for comprehensive information on age limits and relaxations.
